explication: MiniCPM-V and MiniCPM-o are multimodal language models intended for efficient deployment: V handles image, video, and text understanding, while o adds streaming audio/video interaction and speech output. The interactive workflow runs from a user-facing demo through a server to model inference; separate branches support fine-tuning and benchmark evaluation. The sampled server and inference code support those flows, but model-loading details and several README-described capabilities were not inspected, so links to their internals are omitted where uncertain.
